project: Reality authoring controls - playtest + AI-eval composite/stats
note: Menthol EDIT ME handles. Draft/unsigned only. Label ranges are advice, not clamps. Stats producer params (conf/seed/n_boot) must match adopted fragment constants.

mode.label: Project mode
mode.hint: playtest = share bar on tutorial logs. ai_eval = composite refusal gate. stats = Wilson lower-CI bar on make_stats tables.

pass_bar.label: Share who must finish unaided (playtest)
pass_bar.hint: Typical 0.7 to 0.9. Label advice, not a clamp.

time_budget_s.label: Seconds allowed in the tutorial
time_budget_s.hint: Higher makes the bar easier to meet.

require_no_external_help.label: Count external help as not finishing
require_no_external_help.hint: When on, only unaided finishes count toward the share.

enabled.label: Use composite Gate (refusal A AND no-regression B)
enabled.hint: Builds a two-part unsigned measure. Off uses playtest/stats mode instead.

bar_b.label: Harmful-refusal bar on set B (no regression)

evals_a.label: Eval run file for set A
evals_a.hint: evals_A.tsv from make_evals / make_stats data folder

evals_b.label: Eval run file for set B

enabled.label: Wilson lower-CI bar on stats table
enabled.hint: Uses make_stats.py output. Params conf/seed/n_boot are pinned in the fragment.

wilson_lo_bar.label: Require Wilson lower 95% CI at least

conf.label: Confidence level (pinned)
conf.hint: Must match make_stats CONF and fragment cell check (0.95).

second_bar_enabled.label: Also try a looser playtest candidate bar

second_bar.label: Looser share bar
second_bar.hint: Used only when the looser-candidate toggle is on.

enabled.label: Compare candidate orderings (question)
enabled.hint: Forms a weighted pair question on scores.tsv. Answers are not claims.
